caption: The drawing depicts a central, large, ornate jug or pitcher rendered in shades of gray on a beige background. The jug has a wide, flared mouth, a pronounced handle, and a rounded body. The surface of the jug is decorated with detailed reliefs of corn cobs and flowing leaves, which are integrated into the design. The handle appears organic, resembling a stem or stalk that curves from the rim to the body. On the upper right and lower left corners, there are two smaller, detailed sketches of the jug from different angles, both emphasizing the same decorative motif. In the lower right corner, there is a small line drawing with dimensions, outlining the basic form of the jug with the number "7 3/8" written near the mouth. The artwork uses shading to depict form and texture, giving a sense of three-dimensionality. Overall, all objects in the image are rendered using graphite or pencil, resulting in a monochrome composition.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
